selected_primary_idea.title: Joint spin-support and antinodal-coherence discriminator for d-wave pairing
selected_primary_idea.research_object: cuprate d-wave pairing scale along a controlled doping trajectory
selected_primary_idea.mechanism_relation: lambda_d(p)=lambda0*S(p)*Z_AN(p), compared with a spin-only baseline lambda0*S(p)
falsification_conditions: The baseline has equal or lower held-out endpoint error than the joint model.
The inferred coherence factor has no robust contribution after family, temperature, and instrumental controls.
The joint model fails to reproduce the pre-registered ordering of underdoped and near-optimal points.
selected_primary_idea.validation_path: synchronized neutron/RIXS magnetic data, ARPES coherence measures, resonant x-ray charge-order measures, and transport or thermodynamic Tc on the same materials
known_limitations: causal ordering requires intervention or stronger identification
